data.title: Sihasak: Cambodia distorting accounts
data.description: Thailand has accused Cambodia of distorting discussions under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (Unclos) by selectively presenting the outcome and linking maritime boundary issues to unrelated land border clashes.

data.title: Ministry advises against travel to Europe
data.description: The Foreign Affairs Ministry has advised Thai travellers to postpone non-essential trips to European countries affected by unrest, citing protests and rapidly changing conditions in France, Italy and Spain.

data.title: PP urges B16bn boost to support SMEs
data.description: The People's Party (PP) has called on the government to use 16 billion baht in digital tax revenue to strengthen small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), support startups and reduce the country's dependence on foreign digital platforms.

data.title: Civil groups fear political sway over funds
data.description: Civil society networks have urged the Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) to withdraw four bills on sin-tax revenue management, warning they could undermine the independence of public-service media and health and welfare organisations.

data.title: Dinosaur prints safeguarded
data.description: The government is considering legal safeguards to protect six dinosaur footprints dating back 120 million years in Udon Thani and prevent damage to the prehistoric evidence.

data.title: Govt 'flexible' on censure debate timing
data.description: The government may offer the opposition additional hours if the proposed dates for the no-confidence debate against 18 ministers cannot be changed, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said.

data.title: Coral bleaching risk on the rise
data.description: Thailand could face prolonged coral bleaching as sea temperatures rise above 30.5C under a possible Super El Niño, threatening marine ecosystems and potentially delaying the rainy season, a marine scientist has warned.

data.title: Adopt AI-driven future, says Dhanin
data.description: Thailand needs a comprehensive overhaul to seize opportunities in an economy shaped by artificial intelligence, says Dhanin Chearavanont, senior chairman of Charoen Pokphand Group.

data.title: BMA steps up flood aid payments
data.description: Bangkok is accelerating flood compensation payments as more than one million claims face delays due to incomplete documents, eligibility checks, and suspected irregularities.

data.title: Hat Yai can handle flood threat: PM
data.description: Authorities are fully prepared to manage flooding in Songkhla's Hat Yai district, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, as heavy rainfall raises concerns about a repeat of last year's severe floods.

data.title: BJT MP faces questions on spouse's role
data.description: Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap faces questions over her decision to serve as secretary to the digital economy minister while her husband held shares in an online gambling business.

data.title: Minister orders probe into Koh Phangan villa projects
data.description: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has ordered an urgent investigation into villa developments on Koh Phangan following complaints that prolonged rock excavation and drilling have disturbed residents.

data.title: Seized matcha leaves tea lovers hoping for auction
data.description: The seizure of almost 1,000 packs of undeclared matcha green tea powder from Japan, worth more than 500,000 baht, has eager Thai matcha lovers asking whether and when the goods will be put up for auction.

data.title: Pakistani businessman ‘bought Thai ID’ 20 years ago
data.description: A Pakistani fabric store owner in Pattani province has been arrested for allegedly using the identity of a Thai national to obtain a Thai ID card, allowing him to live and run a business in Thailand for nearly 20 years.

data.title: Nominee hunt targets Chon Buri properties worth B800m
data.description: CHON BURI - Police raided 12 properties worth a combined 800 million baht in Bang Lamung district on Wednesday morning, suspecting them of being illegally owned by foreigners.

data.title: Norwegian fugitive wanted for attempted murder arrested
data.description: SAMUT PRAKAN - Thai authorities are preparing to deport a 19-year-old Norwegian man wanted on attempted murder charges in his home country after arresting him on Wednesday.

data.title: Activist group says grey business crackdown falling short
data.description: A political activist group has urged national police chief Samran Nualma to step up efforts to crack down on grey businesses, scam gangs and online gambling — and on the public officials who turn a blind eye to illegality.

data.title: PM’s new narcotics bill equates possession with trafficking
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has submitted amendment bills that would intensify drug suppression through longer detention, greater data access for authorities and a redefinition of all drug possessors as traffickers.

data.title: Bangkok college move to go ahead, says minister
data.description: Higher Education Minister Yodchanan Wongsawat has confirmed plans to relocate a central Bangkok vocational college at the centre of decades-old land dispute, despite student protests, pledging support to minimise disruption during the 90-day transition.

data.title: Suvarnabhumi denies online claim of luggage search
data.description: Suvarnabhumi airport has said it has not found any evidence that its staff opened and searched a passenger’s luggage, responding to a Thai travel blogger who claimed online that her belongings had been rummaged through.
